subject: Renewal closure: invoice issuance, escrow release & EU VAT evidence
messages:
From: John Lee <john.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Renewal closeout: invoice & escrow hold for Acme Analytics

Hi Tessa,

Hope you're well — we're getting our procurement sign-off in place for the renewal that goes live 2027-01-01. A couple of finance items we need to close before the contract is marked 'completed':

- Final true-up invoice for usage over the term (we expect ~€12.3k additional)
- Confirmation on how Redwood will apply EU VAT — we need either an invoice with VAT charged or documentation for reverse charge treatment
- Release of the escrowed funds (you hold an escrow per SOW §5) upon receipt of final invoice and remittance confirmation

Can you send the draft final invoice and tell me what evidence you need for VAT/reverse-charge? Ideally we'd sign/approve this week so Treasury can schedule payment in the Dec 15 run.

Thanks,
John Lee
Head of Procurement
Acme Analytics

PS: cc'ing Finance at finance@acme-analytics.com for visibility.

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: John Lee <john.lee@acme-analytics.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics Finance <finance@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 11:03:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal closeout: invoice & escrow hold for Acme Analytics

Hi John — thanks for the note and the timeline. Quick answers up front, followed by a short next-steps list.

1) Draft invoice attached: redwood_final_invoice_draft_5472.pdf (shows the true-up line items and currency in EUR). We will issue the final PDF once we confirm VAT treatment and the exact remittance method.

2) VAT: for EU customers we typically support two workflows:
   - Charge VAT (we invoice with VAT included) — we will need your EU VAT registration number and a billing address; or
   - Reverse charge (0% VAT on our invoice) — we need a copy of your valid VAT certificate showing intra-EU business status and the VAT ID you plan to use for the reverse charge.

3) Escrow release: Redwood can release the escrow within 2 business days of confirmed payment (payment notice + bank remittance). For ACH/wire we require a remittance file or bank confirmation.

Next steps I propose:
- You send VAT certificate + confirmation of which VAT flow you want (charge vs reverse-charge).
- We'll finalize the invoice and send a signed PDF for your AP to process.
- Treasury schedules payment; we confirm receipt and trigger escrow release.

I copied Redwood Billing (laura.bennett@redwood.com) and Collections (marissa.cole@redwood.com) so they can take over the invoice issuance and follow-up.

If you want us to prepare a separate SOW-closing memo for legal, I can include Rafael from Legal Ops.

Best,
Tessa Morgan
Account Lead, EMEA Renewals
Redwood Inference
redwood.com

Attachment: redwood_final_invoice_draft_5472.pdf (invoice draft, PDF stub)

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Cc: rafael.mendes@redwood.com, john.lee@acme-analytics.com
Date: Fri, 4 Dec 2026 15:28:00 -0500
Subject: FW: Renewal closeout: invoice & escrow hold for Acme Analytics

Laura / Marissa — forwarding the thread. Action items for Billing/Collections:

- Please prepare the final invoice for DL-5472 using the draft attached (redwood_final_invoice_draft_5472.pdf). John indicated ~€12,300 in true-up usage; confirm amounts on the final PDF.
- Tax treatment: Acme may provide a VAT certificate for reverse charge. If they do, apply 0% VAT and include the reverse charge line and their VAT ID in the invoice footer. If we don't receive that by COB Tue 8 Dec, proceed with charging VAT at the applicable rate (they'll need to reclaim as appropriate).
- Escrow: SOW §5 requires escrow release on confirmed remittance. We need Collections to confirm the release procedure and hold the SOW closing memo until funds clear.

I've attached the signed SOW (signed_sow_5472.pdf) for reference to the escrow clause. Rafael — can Legal Ops confirm the exact escrow release wording we should include in the invoice cover note?

Thanks — please mark as high priority; customer wants payment scheduled by Dec 15.

Best,
Tessa

Attachment: signed_sow_5472.pdf (contract stub)

From: John Lee <john.lee@acme-analytics.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Acme Analytics Finance <finance@acme-analytics.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, marissa.cole@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 17:43:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Renewal closeout: invoice & escrow hold for Acme Analytics

Tessa / team — quick update from Finance:

- We've attached Acme's VAT certificate (acme_vat_cert_2026.pdf) and remittance notice for the Dec 15 run (remittance_notice_ACH.pdf). We will process payment by ACH on Dec 15.
- Please issue the final invoice showing reverse charge (0% VAT) and include Acme VAT ID: EU987654321. We also need your signed invoice PDF for our records.

If you can send the signed final invoice today, Treasury will queue it for Dec 15 payment and we will upload remittance confirmation once executed. Once payment clears, please release escrow per the SOW.

Thanks for the fast coordination — appreciate you pulling this together.

John Lee
Head of Procurement
Acme Analytics

Attachments: acme_vat_cert_2026.pdf (VAT cert stub); remittance_notice_ACH.pdf (payment stub)
